metadata.warning: Pairs are heterogeneous: most are French coastal legs or French-rescue returns, not Channel crossings. Only pairs with includes_cross_channel_leg=true involve the crossing, and none gives a full launch-to-landfall navigated distance. Do not draw as tracks; do not infer route-length trends.

origin.name: La Brèche, Utah Beach, Sainte-Marie-du-Mont (Manche, 50) - per the mayor, reported by ICI/AFP
origin.geometry_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim search; query 'Utah Beach, Sainte-Marie-du-Mont, France'; top result 'Utah-Beach, Sainte-Marie-du-Mont, Cherbourg, Manche, Normandie, France métropolitaine, 50480, France' (node 2329239613, place/hamlet); geocoding-log.json key 'utah-beach'

destination.name: Eastney, Portsmouth, England (ICI/AFP: marina d'Eastney; BBC: Eastney Landing; landing coordinates not published)
destination.geometry_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim search; query 'Eastney, Portsmouth, United Kingdom'; top result 'Eastney, Portsmouth, England, PO4 9FZ, United Kingdom' (node 28972113, place/suburb); geocoding-log.json key 'eastney'

evidence.locator: 'environ 140 migrants est signalée au CROSS Jobourg, à l'ouest de la baie de Seine'; 'poursuit sa route vers le Royaume-Uni'; 'Si le départ d'une embarcation de migrants est inhabituel pour la zone'
'partis dans une embarcation pneumatique de Utah Beach ... arrivés à Portsmouth'; 'Selon le maire de Sainte-Marie-du-Mont ... partie de Le Brèche sur la plage d'Utah Beach'
Row '6 September 2026': 625 migrants, 8 boats (all arrivals that day; cannot be attributed to this boat)

'the dinghy involved in Sunday's crossing had launched much further along the French coast, near Cherbourg in the Bay of the Seine - roughly 170 miles from Calais'; 'a crossing that had already taken about 10 hours'; 'bring the group ashore at Eastney Landing in Portsmouth, using lifeboats from Bembridge and Yarmouth on the Isle of Wight'; map graphic 'Migrant boat took 10 hours to make the crossing on Sunday'

'A request to land an RNLI boat carrying more than 100 migrants at the Port of Southampton and the Port of Portsmouth was refused on Sunday'; 'The migrants were instead brought ashore at Eastney Marina'; 'the road leading away from the RNLI Portsmouth Lifeboat Station at the marina' (text supplied by the project owner; page not retrievable)

properties.review_status: source_checked_pending_independent_review; endpoint moved to Eastney and BBC evidence added 2026-09-15
